Data diperoleh melalui penyebaran kuesioner menggunakan Google Form dan dianalisis dengan IBM SPSS Statistics 29 melalui uji validitas, reliabilitas, asumsi klasik, regresi linear berganda, uji t, uji F, dan koefisien determinasi. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa persepsi harga berpengaruh positif dan signifikan terhadap keputusan pembelian dengan nilai t sebesar 9,687 dan signifikansi < 0,001. Sementara itu, promosi cashback tidak berpengaruh signifikan secara parsial terhadap keputusan pembelian dengan nilai t sebesar -0,025 dan signifikansi 0,980. Secara simultan, persepsi harga dan promosi cashback berpengaruh signifikan terhadap keputusan pembelian dengan nilai F sebesar 104,689 dan signifikansi < 0,001. Nilai R Square sebesar 0,675 menunjukkan bahwa kedua variabel independen mampu menjelaskan 67,5% variasi keputusan pembelian. Dengan demikian, persepsi harga menjadi faktor yang berpengaruh terhadap keputusan pembelian, sedangkan promosi cashback tidak menunjukkan pengaruh secara parsial.

latest.title: Housing Price Pressure and Employee Lawsuits: Evidence From China
latest.venue: Journal of International Financial Management and Accounting
latest.abstract: ABSTRACT This study explores how rising housing prices affect employee–employer conflict through the lens of employee lawsuits. Using a sample of Chinese listed firms from 2013 to 2019, we find that the likelihood of employee lawsuits against a firm increases with housing prices in the city where the firm is located. To establish causality, we employ a staggered difference‐in‐differences approach based on the implementation of home purchase restriction policies designed to curb housing price growth, and we also use land supply as an instrument for housing prices. Mechanism and cross‐sectional analyses show that psychological pressure can be the key mechanism driving employee lawsuits. Additional analyses demonstrate that housing price pressure leads to substantiated employee lawsuits instead of vexatious lawsuits. Also, it does not significantly increase other types of litigation, indicating that the psychological pressure primarily affects internal labor relations rather than external stakeholder disputes. These findings indicate that external cost‐of‐living pressures can erode workplace relations and escalate labor conflict. Overall, our paper provides novel evidence on how macroeconomic housing market conditions shape employee–employer dynamics and labor litigation.

latest.title: Pengaruh Harga di E-Commerce dan Store Atmosphere Pasar Modern terhadap Minat Beli Pakaian di Pasar Tradisional Kabupaten Lombok Timur
latest.venue: Jurnal Semesta Ilmu Manajemen dan Ekonomi
latest.abstract: Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk menganalisis pengaruh Harga di E-Commerce dan Store Atmosphere Pasar Modern terhadap Minat Beli Pakaian di Pasar Tradisional Kabupaten Lombok Timur. Penelitian ini menggunakan metode kuantitatif dengan jenis penelitian asosiatif kausal. Sampel penelitian berjumlah 100 responden yang ditentukan melalui teknik purposive sampling dengan kriteria berusia 18 tahun ke atas, pernah melakukan pembelian pakaian di pasar tradisional Kabupaten Lombok Timur, pernah menggunakan e-commerce untuk membeli pakaian, serta pernah berbelanja di pasar modern. Data dikumpulkan menggunakan kuesioner dengan skala Likert dan dianalisis menggunakan regresi linear berganda dengan bantuan SPSS. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa Harga di E-Commerce berpengaruh positif dan signifikan terhadap Minat Beli dengan koefisien regresi sebesar 0,318, nilai t hitung sebesar 4,190 > t tabel sebesar 1,984, dan nilai signifikansi p < 0,05. Variabel Store Atmosphere Pasar Modern juga berpengaruh signifikan terhadap Minat Beli dengan koefisien regresi sebesar 0,367, nilai t hitung sebesar 5,276 > t tabel sebesar 1,984, dan nilai signifikansi p < 0,05. Secara simultan, Harga di E-Commerce dan Store Atmosphere Pasar Modern berpengaruh signifikan terhadap Minat Beli dengan nilai F hitung sebesar 42,378 > F tabel sebesar 3,09 dan nilai signifikansi p < 0,05. Temuan ini menunjukkan bahwa pertimbangan harga pakaian di e-commerce serta suasana dan kondisi lingkungan belanja di pasar modern dapat menjadi faktor yang memengaruhi minat beli pakaian di pasar tradisional Kabupaten Lombok Timur.

latest.title: The Role of Service Quality and Price in Customer Satisfaction at Prima Freshmart Tajur Citeureup Fresh Food Retail
latest.venue: ENDLESS International Journal of Future Studies
latest.abstract: The intense competition among various modern and traditional retail formats places customer satisfaction as a crucial factor for survival, particularly within the fresh food retail industry. This quantitative associative study aims to analyze the partial and simultaneous effects of service quality and price perception on customer satisfaction. Data were gathered via questionnaires using an incidental sampling technique among customers of a fresh food retail outlet and were subsequently analyzed through multiple linear regression after ensuring all classical assumptions were satisfied. The findings reveal that both service quality and price contribute positively and significantly to shaping customer satisfaction, both partially and simultaneously. Between the two variables, price perception exerts a more dominant influence on customer satisfaction. Although overall customer satisfaction is high, the evaluation indicates minor weaknesses in employee responsiveness and price competitiveness. Therefore, management is advised to prioritize enhancing service speed during peak hours and conducting regular price monitoring to strengthen competitiveness and encourage positive word-of-mouth recommendations.

latest.title: Service Quality and Price Perception as Predictors of Customer Satisfaction in Logistics Services
latest.venue: ENDLESS International Journal of Future Studies
latest.abstract: This study aims to examine the influence of service quality and price on customer satisfaction at a logistics service company. Using a quantitative approach with an associative design, data were collected through a Likert-scale questionnaire from a group of customers selected through purposive sampling. The data were then analyzed using multiple linear regression after all classical assumption tests were met. The results show that, partially, price perception has a positive and significant relationship with customer satisfaction. In contrast, service quality shows a positive relationship but has no statistically significant effect after controlling for price. Simultaneously, the two factors together contribute significantly to explaining variation in customer satisfaction. The indicator evaluation shows that price perception is the dominant determinant in the model, while the company’s consistency in fulfilling service promises is assessed as the weakest point requiring special attention. Given the limited sample size and the non-probability method of selecting respondents, the results of this study should not be widely generalized to the entire logistics service industry beyond the scope of the study.

latest.title: DETERMINASI KEPUASAN PENGUNJUNG HOTEL DI KAWASAN LAWEYAN SURAKARTA
latest.venue: Journal of Information System Applied Management Accounting and Research
latest.abstract: Objektif penelitian ini mencakup analisis daya pengaruh secara bersamaan maupun sepihak fasilitas hotel, persepsi harga, promosi, lokasi hotel, kualitas pelayanan, proses reservasi, dan penanganan keluhan terhadap kepuasan pengunjung Hotel Laweyan, serta identifikasi aspek yang paling dominan dan paling tidak dominan daya pengaruhnya. Penelitian ini mengaplikasikan metode kuantitatif dengan pengolahan data menggunakan SPSS. Hasil pengujian menunjukkan bahwa kuesioner reliabel dan layak digunakan. Seluruh koefisien regresi variabel penyebab bernilai positif, yang menunjukkan hubungan searah dengan kepuasan pengunjung sebagai variabel akibat. Secara bersamaan, ketujuh variabel penyebab memiliki daya pengaruh signifikan terhadap kepuasan pengunjung sebesar 92.4%, sedangkan 7.6% sisanya dipengaruhi oleh faktor lain di luar model penelitian, seperti nilai tambah, pengalaman pengunjung, kualitas makanan, program loyalitas, serta kesesuaian reputasi hotel dengan pengalaman aktual pengunjung. Secara sepihak, proses reservasi memiliki daya pengaruh paling dominan terhadap kepuasan pengunjung. Sebaliknya, penanganan keluhan memiliki daya pengaruh paling tidak dominan dan tidak signifikan secara statistik. Temuan ini menegaskan pentingnya proses reservasi dalam membentuk kepuasan pengunjung. Oleh karena itu, pengelola Hotel Laweyan perlu mempertahankan kemudahan reservasi serta meningkatkan kualitas aspek pelayanan lainnya secara berkelanjutan. The objectives of this study are to analyze the simultaneous and partial effects of hotel facilities, price perception, promotion, hotel location, service quality, reservation process, and complaint handling on guest satisfaction at Hotel Laweyan, and to identify the aspects with the strongest and weakest effects. latest.title: Empirical exploration of the circular economy potential model: A workshop-based pilot study in product development
latest.abstract: Abstract Circular economy principles need to be translated into concrete product development decisions early in the design process. The Circular Economy Potential Model (CEPM) supports this translation by guiding product developers from circular economy potentials to action fields, measures, methods, and implementation planning. This article presents an initial empirical exploration of the CEPM in a workshop-based pilot study with 14 trained engineers from academic and industrial contexts. Participants completed a circular product improvement task first without methodological support and then with the CEPM. The study combined an exploratory descriptive analysis of standardized task outputs with questionnaire-based measures of motivation, perceived learning and application, anticipated outcomes, and affective reactions. The exploratory analysis of task outputs indicated clearer linkages between circularity-related improvement opportunities, measures, and associated methods in the CEPM-supported condition, although the pattern was not uniform across outputs. Compared with the unassisted condition, subjective evaluations were descriptively more favorable in the CEPM-supported condition across all positively framed measures, whereas negative affect was lower, particularly pronounced differences concerned perceived knowledge, anticipated applicability, and instrumentality. Due to the small sample and fixed order of conditions, the results should be interpreted as preliminary. Overall, the study moves the CEPM from conceptual development toward empirical investigation and provides a basis for examining when, how, and for whom structured reflection can support the translation of circular economy ambitions into product development action. latest.title: The Mediating Role of eWOM and Customer Experience in the Relationship between Perceived Satisfaction and Customer Loyalty Toward Local Beauty Products
latest.abstract: Background: The growing intensity of competition within the local beauty industry underscores the need to understand the factors that influence customer loyalty. Objective: This study seeks to examine the effect of Perceived Satisfaction on Customer Loyalty and to evaluate the mediating role of eWOM and Customer Experience within this relationship. Methods: Data were obtained from 451 respondents who use local beauty products by means of an online survey and were analyzed with the SEM-PLS method. Results: The findings show that Perceived Satisfaction positively affects Customer Loyalty, eWOM, and Customer Experience. Nevertheless, eWOM and Customer Experience neither significantly affect loyalty nor mediate the relationship between satisfaction and loyalty. These results emphasize that Perceived Satisfaction continues to be the principal factor in fostering loyalty, whereas the effectiveness of digital channels and user experience hinges on trust and emotional engagement. Conclusion: This study offers practical guidance for local beauty industry participants to concentrate on enhancing Perceived Satisfaction and on establishing authentic, trustworthy communication in the digital sphere.

latest.title: PERAN MEDIASI PERCEIVED VALUE PADA PENGARUH PERSEPSI HARGA, BUNDLING MENU, DAN KUALITAS PELAYANAN TERHADAP KEPUASAN KONSUMEN COFFEE TRUCK KOPISTA MEGA MAS MANADO
latest.venue: JURNAL RISET EKONOMI, MANAJEMEN, BISNIS DAN AKUNTANSI
latest.abstract: The increasingly intense coffee business competition in Manado City requires business operators, including Coffee Truck Kopista, to understand the factors shaping customer satisfaction. This study aims to analyze the effect of price perception, menu bundling, and service quality on customer satisfaction with perceived value as a mediating variable. The study used a quantitative associative approach, Likert scale questionnaire, and accidental sampling on 150 consumers of Coffee Truck Kopista Mega Mas Manado. Instrument testing, classical assumption tests, and path analysis were conducted using JASP software. The results show that price perception, menu bundling, and service quality each have a positive and significant effect on perceived value as well as on customer satisfaction, both directly and through perceived value. All three mediation paths are positive and significant (p < 0.001), indicating partial mediation. All six proposed hypotheses are accepted. The implication is that Kopista needs to maintain price affordability, design attractive menu bundling, and preserve service quality to create high perceived value and increase customer satisfaction. Keywords: Price perception, menu bundling, service quality, perceived value, customer satisfaction.

latest.title: Strengthening Financial Management of OK OCE-Supported MSMEs to Enhance Business Sustainability
latest.abstract: Background: Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) play an important role in local economic development and employment creation, yet many face financial management challenges that may hinder effective business management and long-term sustainability.Aims: This Community Service Program aimed to strengthen the financial management capacity of OK OCE-supported MSMEs through practical training and mentoring in simple bookkeeping, cash flow management, financial planning, and the separation of personal and business finances.Methods: The program involved 30 MSME participants and employed a participatory approach consisting of needs assessment, pre-test, financial management training, contextual practical exercises, direct mentoring, discussion and consultation, post-test, and follow-up evaluation. Program outcomes were assessed by comparing pre-test and post-test scores across five financial management indicators.Results: Participants demonstrated an average immediate post-program improvement of 41.6 percentage points across the five indicators, with improvements ranging from 40 to 43 percentage points. The greatest improvement was observed in simple budgeting, which increased from 35% to 78% (+43 percentage points).Conclusion: The training and mentoring program was associated with immediate improvements in participants’ understanding of basic financial management, particularly in financial recording, cash flow management, budgeting, separation of personal and business finances, and the use of financial information for decision-making. These improvements provide a foundation for more structured financial management practices, while their longer-term contribution to business resilience and sustainability requires further follow-up evaluation.
keywords: separation of personal and business finances

latest.title: Membentuk Keputusan Pembelian Konsumen: Sinergi Digital Entrepreneurship, Persepsi Harga dan Kualitas Produk Studi Pada Konsumen Jatinangor House Kota Bogor
latest.abstract: This study aims to analyze and determine 1) The Influence of Digital Entrepreneurship on Purchase Decisions, 2) The Influence of Price Perception on Purchase Decisions, 3) The Influence of Product Quality on Purchase Decisions of Jatinangor House consumens in Bogor City. The development of a competitive culinary industry in the digital economy era requires business actors to integrate technology and maintain product value alignment in order to influence consumer behavior. The type of research used is a quantitative approach with a survey method. Primary data collection was conducted through the distribution of structured questionnaires with a Likert scale to 180 respondents selected using non-probability sampling technique with a purposive sampling approach, which is a sampling technique based on certain criteria established by the researcher. The criteria for respondents are Jatinangor House consumens in Bogor City who have made a product purchase. The data analysis method used in this research is Structural Equation Modeling (SEM) through the Partial Least Squares (SEM-PLS) analysis tool with the assistance of SmartPLS 4.0 software. The results of hypothesis testing show that: 1) Digital Entrepreneurship has a positive and significant effect on Purchase Decisions with a t-statistic value of 3.021 and a p-value of 0.003, 2) Price Perception has a positive and significant effect on Purchase Decisions with a t-statistic value of 1.988 and a p-value of 0.047, and finally 3) Product Quality has a positive and significant effect on Purchase Decisions with a t-statistic value of 6.493 and a p-value of 0.000 The results of this study show that the variables of Digital Entrepreneurship, Price Perception, and Product Quality have a positive and significant influence on the Purc

latest.title: Brand Experience, Engagement, and Loyalty in Iraqi Retail
latest.venue: Central Asian Journal of Innovations on Tourism Management and Finance
latest.abstract: In Iraqi cities the shopper can buy the same product category from a neighbourhood shop, from a regional chain or from an international brand store, so the question why a customer returns to one brand is a practical one for the retailers there. In this study, the mediating role of customer engagement in the association between brand experience and customer loyalty has been examined in Iraqi urban retail markets, together with the moderating role of perceived value on the association between engagement and loyalty. A cross-sectional survey was carried out with a convenience sample of consumers, mainly in Baghdad, Mosul and Tikrit, where each respondent rated a brand bought in the previous three months. From 300 returns, 263 usable responses remained after the screening for missing data, straight-lining and multivariate outliers. The conditional process model (PROCESS Model 14) was estimated with 5,000 bias-corrected bootstrap resamples. It can be noted from the results that brand experience was positively associated with customer engagement (b = 0.533, p < .001) and with loyalty (total effect b = 0.506, p < .001), and engagement was related also positively to loyalty (b = 0.453, p < .001). The indirect effect of brand experience on loyalty through engagement was 0.242 (95% CI [0.162, 0.334]) and the direct path stayed significant, so the mediation is partial. The engagement × perceived value interaction was positive (b = 0.170, p = .032), and the index of moderated mediation was 0.092 (95% CI [0.008, 0.189]). This means that engagement carries a part of the link between experience and loyalty, and this part becomes larger when the customer judges that the brand gives more for its price. latest.title: A Study on Consumer Buying Behaviour in the Cosmetic Industry in India
latest.abstract: Abstract This paper explores buyer behaviour in the Indian cosmetic market, considering the demographic, psychological, socio-cultural, and digital influencing factors. As the market is growing fast and getting more digital, it has become critical to comprehend the changing consumer motivations. The literature review chapter critically looks at the literature review on the consumer buying behaviour of the cosmetic industry in India, and analyses the demographic, psychological, cultural, and digital factors influencing consumer buying behaviour. The secondary results indicate that cosmetic purchasing behaviour in India is multidimensional and the interplay of socio-economic, psychological assessment, cultural identity, and digital influence. Income and value perception influence brand choice, and specialised categories, green and halal cosmetics, depend on environmental concern and religiosity. The purchase and repurchase intention are strongly based on perceived quality and brand trust. Further, online marketing and social media activate decision-making processes faster by influencing attitudes, improving access to information and strengthening social validation.

latest.title: Pengaruh Scarcity Marketing dan Gamifikasi Shopee Terhadap Impulse Buying Mahasiswa Pengguna Shopee
latest.abstract: Scarcity marketing and gamification are commonly used in e-commerce platforms to attract consumers and encourage purchasing decisions. However, their relationship with students’ impulse buying behavior requires further examination. This study aims to analyze the effects of Shopee’s scarcity marketing and gamification on impulse buying among student users. A quantitative approach was employed using a survey method, with data collected from 30 respondents. The data were analyzed using multiple linear regression and statistical significance tests. The results indicate that scarcity marketing has a negative but statistically insignificant effect on impulse buying (regression coefficient = −0.195; significance = 0.449). Shopee gamification has a positive but statistically insignificant effect (regression coefficient = 0.274; significance = 0.336). Simultaneously, the two independent variables do not significantly affect impulse buying (F = 0.504; significance = 0.610). These findings suggest that, within the scope of this sample, scarcity marketing and gamification are insufficient to explain students’ impulse buying behavior. Further research involving larger samples and additional consumer-related variables is recommended.

latest.title: Beyond Price: Understanding the Interplay Between Perceived Value, Customer Satisfaction, and Purchase Intention Among Generation Z Consumers
latest.abstract: Understanding the factors that shape Generation Z's purchase intention is increasingly important in the fast-food industry, where price perceptions and customer experiences play critical roles in consumer decision-making. Although previous studies have examined the relationships between price, customer satisfaction, and purchase intention, further investigation is needed to clarify the mediating role of customer satisfaction in the relationship between price perception and purchase intention, particularly among Generation Z consumers in the fast-food sector. Therefore, this study examines the direct effect of price perception on purchase intention, the effect of customer satisfaction on purchase intention, the effect of price perception on customer satisfaction, and customer satisfaction's mediating role in the relationship between price perception and purchase intention. A quantitative explanatory research design was employed using primary data collected through questionnaires distributed to 100 Generation Z consumers of Mie Gacoan. The sample size was determined using the Lemeshow formula. This study contributes to consumer behavior literature by clarifying the mediating mechanism through which customer satisfaction connects price perceptions with Generation Z's purchase intention in the fast-food context. Practically, the findings offer insights into fast-food businesses to develop competitive pricing strategies while maintaining customer satisfaction to strengthen purchase intention among younger consumers.

latest.title: UNDERSTANDING GEN-Z’S ATTITUDE TOWARDS PENANG’S LOCAL FOOD: THE ROLE OF EMOTIONAL, PRESTIGE, AND QUALITY-VALUES
latest.venue: Quantum Journal of Social Sciences and Humanities
latest.abstract: Penang’s local food creates an important element of the state’s cultural identity and serves as a key driver of tourism attractiveness. As Generation Z (Gen-Z) increasingly becomes a prominent consumer group in both the food and travel industries, understanding their perceptions and engagement with local food experiences has become increasingly important for sustaining culinary tourism and preserving cultural heritage. This study aims to examine the factors that contribute to Gen-Z’s attitude towards Penang’s local food by focusing on three variables which is emotional value, prestige value and quality value. A quantitative cross-sectional survey design was employed, utilizing a self-administered questionnaire distributed to 431 Gen-Z respondents aged 18-29 years in Malaysia who had prior experience consuming Penang's local food. Convenience sampling was used, and data were analyzed using Pearson correlation and multiple regression analyses. Results indicated that all three variables significantly influence Gen-Z’s attitudes with prestige value emerging as the strongest predicator, followed by quality and emotional value. These findings suggest that social recognition, sensory satisfaction and emotional connections play an essential role in shaping young consumers’ perception of local food. The study provides useful insights for tourism authorities, local food businesses, and cultural stakeholders to develop more effective strategies in preserving Penang’s culinary heritage while aligning with the preferences of the younger generation in a rapidly digitalized and globalized food culture.

latest.title: Pengaruh Online Influencer Marketing, Persepsi Harga, dan Kepercayaan Konsumen terhadap Keputusan Pembelian pada Marketplace Shopee
latest.venue: Indonesian Journal of Innovation Multidisipliner Research
latest.abstract: Keputusan pembelian melalui marketplace melibatkan evaluasi terhadap informasi ulasan, kesesuaian harga, dan keandalan penjual. Meskipun ketiga aspek tersebut dapat membantu konsumen mengurangi ketidakpastian transaksi, penelitian terdahulu menunjukkan hasil yang beragam mengenai hubungannya dengan keputusan pembelian. Penelitian ini bertujuan menganalisis pengaruh online customer review, persepsi harga, dan kepercayaan konsumen terhadap keputusan pembelian mahasiswa Fakultas Ekonomi dan Bisnis Universitas Sains Al-Qur’an Jawa Tengah di Wonosobo pada marketplace Shopee. Penelitian menggunakan pendekatan kuantitatif melalui survei terhadap 60 responden yang dipilih secara purposif. Data dikumpulkan menggunakan kuesioner dengan 15 butir pernyataan berskala Likert lima tingkat. Analisis meliputi statistik deskriptif, pengujian kualitas instrumen, pemeriksaan asumsi regresi, dan regresi linier berganda. Pengujian koefisien menggunakan galat baku robust untuk mengakomodasi indikasi heteroskedastisitas. Hasil menunjukkan bahwa seluruh butir memenuhi kriteria korelasi butir–total dan seluruh variabel memiliki konsistensi internal yang memadai. Online customer review, persepsi harga, dan kepercayaan konsumen masing-masing berhubungan positif dan signifikan dengan keputusan pembelian setelah prediktor lainnya dikendalikan. Model menjelaskan 56,75% variasi keputusan pembelian, dengan koefisien determinasi yang disesuaikan sebesar 54,43%. Temuan ini menunjukkan bahwa kualitas informasi ulasan, penilaian harga yang positif, dan kepercayaan terhadap penjual merupakan pertimbangan yang relevan dalam pembelian melalui Shopee. Penjual dapat memanfaatkan temuan tersebut untuk memperjelas informasi produk, menjaga kesesuaian harga dengan manfaat, dan meningkatkan keandalan pelayanan. Gen

latest.title: ปัจจัยที่มีอิทธิพลต่อการตัดสินใจซื้อโลงศพ ของผู้บริโภคในปีพุทธศักราช 2569
latest.abstract: This research aimed to: 1) study personal factors affecting coffin purchase decisions; 2) examine purchasing behaviors affecting coffin purchase decisions; and 3) investigate the relationship between the marketing mix and social beliefs regarding coffin purchase decisions. The research hypotheses suggested that: (1) differences in personal factors lead to different coffin purchase decisions; (2) differences in purchasing behaviors lead to different coffin purchase decisions; and (3) marketing mix factors and social beliefs significantly influence coffin purchase decisions. This quantitative study collected data via online questionnaires from a sample of 400 consumers aged 30 years and above who do not practice Islam, residing in Bangkok, Prachinburi, Samut Prakan, Pathum Thani, and Nonthaburi, selected through convenience sampling. The data were analyzed using frequency, percentage, mean, standard deviation, F-test, ANOVA, and Multiple Regression Analysis (MRA). The hypothesis testing results revealed that: (1) Differences in personal factors did not significantly affect coffin purchase decisions. (2) Differences in purchasing behaviors regarding attitudes toward advertisements and purchasing budgets led to significantly different coffin purchase decisions at the 0.05 level, whereas prior experience, information channels, primary organizers, and ritual beliefs did not significantly affect the decisions. (3) All marketing mix factors and social beliefs significantly influenced coffin purchase decisions (p < 0.01). latest.title: E-Service quality and customer satisfaction in online shopping: Implications for sustainable digital commerce
latest.abstract: The rapid growth of e-commerce has intensified competition among online retailers, making e-service quality increasingly important for building customer trust, satisfaction, and sustainable customer-platform relationships. This study examines the relationships among e-service quality, customer trust, customer satisfaction, and customer loyalty using a second-order Structural Equation Modeling (SEM) framework. The five SERVQUAL dimensions such as empathy, responsiveness, reliability, assurance, and tangibles were modeled as first-order constructs reflecting the higher-order construct of service quality. Data were collected through an online questionnaire from 402 respondents with prior online-shopping experience. Confirmatory Factor Analysis (CFA) and SEM were employed to assess the measurement and structural models. The measurement model demonstrated satisfactory reliability, convergent validity, discriminant validity, and overall model fit. The structural results showed that service quality significantly and positively influenced customer trust and customer satisfaction, while customer trust significantly enhanced satisfaction. Trust also partially mediated the relationship between service quality and satisfaction, indicating that e-service quality improves satisfaction both directly and through increased customer confidence. The SERVQUAL dimensions contributed positively to overall service quality, with responsiveness and assurance showing particularly strong contributions, while empathy exhibited a comparatively moderate contribution. In contrast, customer loyalty had no significant direct effect on trust or satisfaction, and its indirect effect on satisfaction through trust was also nonsignificant. latest.title: A Comparative Study of International Tourists’ Experiences at Hangzhou’s Three World Heritage Sites: A Text Mining Approach Based on Online Reviews
latest.venue: International Theory and Practice in Humanities and Social Sciences
latest.abstract: As a renowned tourist destination in China, Hangzhou is home to three UNESCO World Heritage Sites: the West Lake Cultural Landscape, the Grand Canal (Hangzhou Section), and the Liangzhu Archaeological Ruins. With the continuous development of international tourism, gaining a clear understanding of how foreign visitors perceive and evaluate these heritage sites has become increasingly critical for improving destination management and boosting cultural communication. This study explores the experiences of international tourists at Hangzhou's three World Heritage Sites, drawing on English-language online reviews collected from TripAdvisor and Google Reviews. It adopts a mixed-method approach that combines Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA) topic modeling, an improved VADER sentiment analysis method, Importance-Performance Analysis (IPA), and manual content analysis. Based on around 1200 collected online reviews, this research identifies core themes, emotional responses, and potential service problems related to each of these heritage sites. The results show that international visitors hold generally positive attitudes toward all three heritage sites, but their experiences vary in line with the distinct characteristics of each heritage type. West Lake is most commonly associated with natural scenery and cultural landscapes, yet overcrowding remains a key issue that drags down visitor satisfaction. The Grand Canal is strongly linked to historical culture and cruise experiences, though excessive commercialization may erode its cultural authenticity. Liangzhu is primarily recognized for its museum architecture and archaeological value, but insufficient multilingual support and interpretation services hinder international visitors from grasping its full cultural significance. latest.title: Digital Spendthrift Behavior Generasi Z dan Milenial dalam Perspektif Keuangan Islam
latest.abstract: Penelitian ini menganalisis pengaruh Islamic Financial Literacy, Proliferation of Digital Financial Apps, dan Financial Capability in Islamic Perspective terhadap Digital Spendthrift Behavior dengan Proliferation of Digital Advertising sebagai variabel mediasi, sekaligus menguji apakah pola hubungan tersebut berbeda antara Generasi Z dan Milenial. Penelitian menggunakan pendekatan kuantitatif dengan teknik purposive sampling berdasarkan kriteria tertentu dan menghasilkan 342 responden yang memenuhi syarat. Data diolah dengan Partial Least Squares–Structural Equation Modelling (PLS-SEM) yang dilanjutkan dengan Multi-Group Analysis (MGA) untuk membandingkan kedua generasi. Hasil analisis memperlihatkan bahwa Financial Capability in Islamic Perspective berpengaruh negatif dan signifikan terhadap Digital Spendthrift Behavior, sedangkan Proliferation of Digital Financial Apps dan Proliferation of Digital Advertising mendorong meningkatnya perilaku tersebut. Islamic Financial Literacy tidak memengaruhi Digital Spendthrift Behavior secara langsung, tetapi memiliki pengaruh tidak langsung yang signifikan melalui Proliferation of Digital Advertising. Peran mediasi Proliferation of Digital Advertising terbukti signifikan pada jalur Islamic Financial Literacy dan jalur Proliferation of Digital Financial Apps menuju Digital Spendthrift Behavior. Hasil MGA menunjukkan bahwa perbedaan antargenerasi hanya terjadi pada pengaruh langsung Proliferation of Digital Financial Apps terhadap Digital Spendthrift Behavior. Temuan ini menjadi landasan bagi perumusan strategi edukasi yang mempertimbangkan karakter setiap generasi dan berakar pada nilai-nilai keuangan Islam, serta memperkaya literatur melalui integrasi konstruk keuangan Islam dan perbedaan generasi dengan pendekatan PLS-SEM MGA.

latest.title: The Factors Influencing Customer Satisfaction with No-Code WhatsApp Automation: A Study of Yeti
latest.abstract: Quality of Support is the strongest single driver of customer satisfaction with WhatsApp business automation platforms (β = 0.470, p = 0.008), ahead of ease of use, ease of setup and product direction, even though all four attributes are strongly correlated with satisfaction (r = 0.872 to 0.917, p < 0.001). Most research on chatbots and WhatsApp marketing measures the satisfaction of end consumers who chat with a brand. The business customers who buy and run the automation platform, and the platforms themselves as competing products, are almost absent as a unit of analysis. This paper addresses that gap with a cross-sectional analysis of verified G2 user-review scores for 26 WhatsApp and conversational automation platforms, representing 4,512 reviews, collected on 1 October 2026. The study grew out of a summer internship at Yeti (IncrediBee Private Limited), an Ahmedabad-based no-code platform. It tests seven hypotheses on (1–4) the link between each platform attribute and satisfaction, (5) the joint influence of the four attributes, (6) usability differences between no-code and API-based platforms and (7) satisfaction differences between Indian and global platforms. Three findings stand out. First, the four attributes together explain 89.1% of the variation in satisfaction (F = 43.12, p < 0.001), but once they are entered together only support remains individually significant; a reduced model with ease of use and support keeps almost all of that explanatory power (R² = 0.880). Second, no-code platforms are rated easier to use than API/CPaaS providers (Mann–Whitney U = 93.0, p = 0.047). latest.title: Pengaruh Kualitas, Variasi Produk, dan Persepsi Harga terhadap Keputusan Pembelian Sarung Wadimor
latest.abstract: Penurunan dan fluktuasi kekuatan merek Sarung Wadimor menjadi permasalahan yang perlu diperhatikan di tengah persaingan industri sarung yang semakin kompetitif. Kondisi tersebut menunjukkan pentingnya mengetahui faktor-faktor yang memengaruhi keputusan pembelian konsumen. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk menganalisis pengaruh kualitas produk, variasi produk, dan persepsi harga terhadap keputusan pembelian Sarung Wadimor di Kota Bandung. Penelitian menggunakan metode deskriptif dan verifikatif dengan pendekatan kuantitatif. Data primer diperoleh melalui kuesioner yang disebarkan kepada 385 responden masyarakat Kota Bandung yang pernah membeli Sarung Wadimor. Analisis data dilakukan menggunakan Statistical Package for the Social Sciences (SPSS) versi 27 dengan analisis regresi linear berganda. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa kualitas produk, variasi produk, persepsi harga, dan keputusan pembelian berada pada kategori tinggi. Secara parsial, kualitas produk, variasi produk, dan persepsi harga berpengaruh positif dan signifikan terhadap keputusan pembelian. Secara simultan, ketiga variabel tersebut berpengaruh positif dan signifikan terhadap keputusan pembelian. Nilai R² sebesar 0,638 menunjukkan bahwa 63,8% keputusan pembelian dapat dijelaskan oleh ketiga variabel tersebut, sedangkan 36,2% dipengaruhi faktor lain di luar penelitian. Temuan ini menunjukkan pentingnya peningkatan kualitas, pengembangan variasi produk, dan penetapan harga sesuai nilai yang ditawarkan.

latest.title: Optimalisasi Kualitas, Citra Merek, dan Persepsi Harga Terhadap Kepuasan Pelanggan Wardah di Daerah Istimewa Yogyakarta
latest.venue: Journal of Organizational Performance and Analysis
latest.abstract: Kepuasan pelanggan menjadi hal penting dalam menentukan kesuksesan sebuah produk kosmetik, terutama di tengah persaingan yang semakin ketat. Penelitian ini membahas bagaimana kualitas produk, citra merek, dan cara konsumen melihat harga berkontribusi pada kepuasan pelanggan Wardah di Daerah Istimewa Yogyakarta. Penelitian ini melihat masing-masing faktor secara terpisah dan juga bersamaan, serta mencari tahu faktor yang paling berpengaruh. Pendekatan kuantitatif diterapkan melalui analisis regresi linear berganda terhadap jawaban 36 responden. Hasil analisis memperlihatkan kualitas produk dan persepsi harga menghasilkan dampak baik yang relevan terhadap kepuasan pelanggan, dengan nilai signifikansi di bawah 0,001. Sebaliknya, citra merek belum menunjukkan pengaruh parsial yang signifikan karena nilai signifikansinya sebesar 0,259. Ketika ketiga variabel diuji secara simultan, hasilnya tetap signifikan dengan nilai F 308,388 dan p < 0,001. Model regresi mampu menjelaskan 96,7% variasi kepuasan pelanggan, sebagaimana tercermin pada nilai R² 0,967. Kualitas produk tercatat menjadi factor dominan, dengan Standardized Beta senilai 0,562. Temuan ini menekankan bahwa peningkatan kepuasan konsumen Wardah perlu didukung oleh konsistensi mutu produk serta kesamaan antara harga dan manfaat yang dirasakan pelanggan.

latest.title: ANALISIS FAKTOR HARGA, PROMOSI, DAN ULASAN ONLINE DALAM KEPUTUSAN PEMBELIAN ONLINE PADA MAHASISWA UNIVERSITAS TERBUKA SALUT BINA MAHUNIKA BOGOR
latest.venue: Integrative Perspectives of Social and Science Journal
latest.abstract: Penelitian ini bertujuan mendeskripsikan pertimbangan harga, promosi, dan ulasan online dalam keputusan pembelian online mahasiswa Universitas Terbuka SALUT Bina Mahunika Bogor. Penelitian menggunakan pendekatan kualitatif deskriptif. Informan terdiri atas sepuluh mahasiswa yang dipilih secara purposif berdasarkan pengalaman berbelanja melalui marketplace serta pengalaman mempertimbangkan harga, promosi, dan ulasan pelanggan. Data utama diperoleh melalui wawancara semi-terstruktur. Analisis dilakukan melalui kondensasi data, penyajian data, serta penarikan dan verifikasi kesimpulan. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa pertimbangan harga mencakup keterjangkauan, kewajaran harga, perkiraan kualitas, dan biaya pengiriman. Promosi menarik perhatian serta menjadi pertimbangan waktu pembelian, tetapi tidak selalu menghasilkan transaksi. Ulasan online digunakan untuk memeriksa kesesuaian produk, pengalaman pembeli sebelumnya, dan pelayanan penjual. Harga, promosi, dan ulasan online dipertimbangkan secara berkaitan. Penawaran yang murah dan menarik dapat ditolak apabila ulasan menimbulkan keraguan. Penelitian ini menunjukkan bahwa keputusan pembelian informan melibatkan penilaian terhadap kemampuan anggaran, keuntungan penawaran, dan keyakinan terhadap produk.

latest.title: Integrated Marketing Strategy Based on 7P and 7C to Strengthen the Competitiveness of Franchise Micro-Warteg
latest.venue: International Journal of Economics Business and Innovation Research
latest.abstract: This article examines integrated marketing strategy at Warteg Kharisma Bahari Lkr Dramaga as a case study of a micro franchise food stall near the IPB Dramaga area. The study is motivated by the need for small food businesses to move beyond good food and affordable prices by managing communication, service, process, physical evidence, and customer feedback consistently. The article applies an applied case study approach using customer short interview data, employee interview data, store observation, and an assessment of offline and online touchpoints. The analysis combines descriptive quantitative reading and thematic qualitative interpretation using the 7P framework paired with 7C. The findings show that the main value of the food stall lies in taste, menu variety, affordable prices, fast service, QRIS payment, and convincing food display. The main improvement areas are price transparency, promotional signage, Google Maps review governance, coordination during peak hours, and stronger physical evidence. This article proposes a realistic integrated marketing micro toolkit for micro franchisees.

latest.title: PENGARUH KUALITAS PELAYANAN DAN HARGA TERHADAP KEPUTUSAN PEMBELIAN MINYAK GORENG PADA PELANGGAN PT RAJAWALI NUSINDO CABANG TANGERANG
latest.venue: Jurnal Ilmiah Ekonomi Manajemen Bisnis dan Akuntansi.
latest.abstract: Persaingan distribusi minyak goreng yang semakin ketat, termasuk dari pedagang perorangan yang menawarkan harga lebih murah, menuntut distributor memahami faktor yang mendorong keputusan pembelian pelanggannya. Penelitian ini bertujuan untuk menganalisis pengaruh kualitas pelayanan dan harga terhadap keputusan pembelian minyak goreng pada pelanggan PT Rajawali Nusindo Cabang Tangerang. Penelitian menggunakan pendekatan kuantitatif dengan desain asosiatif. Populasi penelitian berjumlah 1.014 pelanggan, dan sampel sebanyak 99 responden ditentukan dengan rumus Slovin serta dipilih melalui teknik accidental sampling. Data dikumpulkan menggunakan kuesioner berisi 42 butir pernyataan dengan skala Likert lima poin, kemudian dianalisis melalui uji validitas dan reliabilitas, uji asumsi klasik, regresi linier sederhana dan berganda, koefisien korelasi dan determinasi, uji t, serta uji F dengan bantuan SPSS 26. Hasil deskriptif menunjukkan bahwa kualitas pelayanan dinilai baik (rata-rata 3,49), sedangkan persepsi harga (3,35) dan keputusan pembelian (3,35) dinilai kurang baik. Secara individual, kualitas pelayanan (koefisien 0,793; t = 13,629; p < 0,05) dan harga (koefisien 1,135; t = 42,200; p < 0,05) berpengaruh positif dan signifikan terhadap keputusan pembelian. Ketika kedua variabel diuji dalam satu model, harga tetap signifikan (t = 23,300; p < 0,05), sedangkan kualitas pelayanan tidak lagi signifikan (t = 0,452; p = 0,652), yang menunjukkan bahwa kontribusinya tumpang tindih dengan persepsi harga pelanggan. Secara simultan, kualitas pelayanan dan harga berpengaruh signifikan terhadap keputusan pembelian (F = 883,204; p < 0,05) dan menjelaskan 94,8% variasinya. latest.title: Persepsi Harga, Kualitas Pelayanan Dan Kemudahan Penggunaan Terhadap Kepuasan Pelanggan Indrive Di Garut
latest.abstract: Maraknya penggunaan aplikasi ride-hailing di Indonesia, termasuk inDrive dengan skema negosiasi tarif langsung antara penumpang dan pengemudi, memunculkan pertanyaan mengenai tingkat kepuasan pengguna terhadap layanan tersebut, khususnya di Kabupaten Garut yang penggunaannya terus meningkat. Penelitian ini bertujuan menganalisis pengaruh persepsi harga, kualitas pelayanan, dan kemudahan penggunaan terhadap kepuasan pelanggan aplikasi inDrive di Kabupaten Garut, baik secara parsial maupun simultan. Penelitian menggunakan metode kuantitatif dengan pendekatan deskriptif-asosiatif terhadap 100 responden yang dipilih melalui accidental sampling, dengan data dianalisis menggunakan SEM-PLS melalui SmartPLS. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa persepsi harga dan kualitas pelayanan berada pada kategori baik, sedangkan kemudahan penggunaan tergolong cukup baik, dan ketiga variabel tersebut baik secara parsial maupun simultan terbukti berpengaruh positif dan signifikan terhadap kepuasan pelanggan, dengan persepsi harga sebagai prediktor paling dominan. Berdasarkan temuan tersebut, pengelola inDrive disarankan meningkatkan transparansi tarif, kualitas layanan pengemudi, dan kemudahan penggunaan aplikasi guna meningkatkan kepuasan pelanggan.

hot.abstract: Advances in Consumer Research (Abbreviated as Adv. Consum. Res.) is a distinguished journal based in the United States and published by Sheridan Books. hot.title: The Impact of Visual Elements of Packaging Design on Purchase Intention: Brand Experience as a Mediator in the Tea Bag Product Category
hot.abstract: While packaging design plays a vital role in experience-oriented markets, how multiple visual elements influence purchase intention through brand experience remains unclear. This study addresses this gap by employing innovative orthogonal experiments to examine the complex relationship between the visual elements of packaging design and purchase intention for low-involvement products, integrating both design and marketing perspectives. Through orthogonal experimental design, we developed 14 packaging prototypes as stimuli by systematically manipulating five visual elements (Colour, Graphics, Logo, Typography, and Layout). The framework and prototypes were validated through expert evaluation. Data were collected via a cross-sectional survey from 490 tea bag consumers and analysed using SPSS (version 29.0) for preliminary data processing and Mplus (version 8.3) for structural equation modelling. Our results reveal the direct effects of visual packaging elements on consumer purchase intention. Notably, Colour, Graphics, Logo, and Layout significantly influence purchase intention through brand experience mediation. Importantly, our multi-level analysis of visual elements unveils distinct patterns in how different design levels (e.g., colour harmony, graphic types) affect consumer responses. This study provides novel theoretical insights into how consumers make purchase decisions based on packaging design visual elements, addressing a significant gap in existing research. Unlike previous studies focusing on isolated design elements, our systematic classification and multi-level analysis offer both theoretical insights into packaging design mechanisms and practical guidelines for designers and practitioners.

hot.title: Factors influencing Generation Z’s intention to purchase sustainable clothing products in Vietnam
hot.abstract: The increasing awareness of environmental challenges has significantly influenced consumer behavior, with sustainable products, particularly sustainable clothing, becoming a top priority for Generation Z consumers. This study aims to investigate the factors influencing Generation Z's purchase intentions toward sustainable clothing in Vietnam, guided by the Stimulus-Organism-Response (SOR) model and Theory of Planned Behavior (TPB) frameworks. Specifically, it examines the effects of green perceived value, green perceived quality, perceived price, social influence, product design, environmental concern, and environmental knowledge on purchase intentions. The study also explores the mediating roles of environmental attitude and product attitude in these relationships. The research employed a quantitative approach, using a Likert scale questionnaire to gather data from 641 Vietnamese Generation Z consumers. The study utilized exploratory factor analysis (EFA), confirmatory factor analysis (CFA), and structural equation modeling (SEM) to analyze the data. The results revealed that all proposed hypotheses were supported, indicating that all factors significantly impact environmental attitude and product attitude, which, in turn, influence purchase intention. The results emphasize the strong mediating role of environmental attitude and product attitude, suggesting that consumers with positive attitudes toward the environment and products are more likely to intend to purchase sustainable clothing. This research provides valuable insights into the psychological and contextual factors that influence Generation Z's sustainable consumption behavior. For marketers, these findings underscore the need to promote transparency in sustainable practices, emphasize high product quality an

hot.title: Digital Tourism and Smart Development: State-of-the-Art Review
hot.abstract: The intersection between digital technologies and tourism emerges as a prominent area of research within the tourism industry. This is primarily driven by the immense complexity of digital tourism itself as a multifaceted social, economic, and cultural phenomenon. This paper reveals the future implications of tourism in the context of digital intelligence. To gain insights into the latest applications of digital tourism, this work reviews 278 studies spanning from 2012 to 2024. A systematic literature analysis method is proposed to identify the research hotspots and trends. Through value co-creation theory and Schumpeter’s innovation theory, five key trajectories are suggested, as follows: in-depth application of digital technologies in tourism, spawning new scenarios, new forms and new modes of digital tourism, and deep integration of digital economy and tourism real economy. This state-of-the-art review will help to reflect the efforts towards promoting the smart development of digital technologies in tourism.

hot.title: Perceived Value, Consumer Engagement, and Purchase Intention in Virtual Influencer Marketing: The Role of Source Credibility and Generational Cohort
hot.venue: Journal of theoretical and applied electronic commerce research
hot.abstract: As virtual influencers gain popularity, understanding the factors driving consumer responses is essential. However, limited research explores how perceived value (informativeness, entertainment, novelty, and incentives) and consumer engagement influence purchase intention. Perceived value is a key predictor of consumer behavior, while consumer engagement enhances perceived value and marketing effectiveness. Additionally, the moderating roles of source credibility and generational cohort remain underexplored. This study examines these relationships through a survey of 331 Chinese Generation Y and Z consumers, analyzed using structural equation modeling (SEM). The results show that informativeness, entertainment, and incentives positively influence purchase intention, while novelty has a negative effect. Consumer engagement drives purchase intention and enhances perceived value. Source credibility and generational cohort moderate these effects. When source credibility is low, novelty reduces purchase intention, while incentives increase it. High source credibility makes consumer engagement more influential. Informativeness enhances purchase intention among Generation Y, whereas Generation Z is more influenced by consumer engagement. This study extends research on advertising value and consumer engagement, offering insights for brands optimizing virtual influencer marketing strategies across different consumer segments.

hot.title: Investigating the factors influencing customer loyalty and the mediating effect of customer satisfaction in online food delivery services: empirical evidence from an emerging market
hot.abstract: This study investigates the factors affecting customer loyalty and the mediating role of customer satisfaction in online food delivery services (OFDS) in Bangladesh. An analysis of 300 responses via structural equation modeling (SEM) revealed that perceived food and service quality alone did not significantly impact customer loyalty. While these qualities are essential, they must enhance customer satisfaction in order to boost loyalty. Significant relationships exist among perceived price, ease of payment, time efficiency, and customer loyalty, with customer satisfaction acting as a crucial mediator. Strategies focusing on pricing, payment convenience, and timely delivery are the most effective for building loyalty. The interplay between perceived quality, pricing, payment, and delivery efficiency enhances the overall customer experience. This study contributes to the literature by applying Attribution Theory and the Technological Acceptance Model (TAM), emphasizing external factors such as pricing, delivery, and payment ease as key loyalty drivers. The findings suggest that OFDS businesses should prioritize reasonable pricing, efficient payment systems, and timely delivery to foster loyalty. Combined with high-quality food and services, these strategies can enhance customer satisfaction, promote business growth, and increase revenue.

hot.title: From Asymmetry to Satisfaction: The Dynamic Role of Perceived Value and Trust to Boost Customer Satisfaction in the Tourism Industry
hot.abstract: The study investigates how information asymmetry affects customer satisfaction in the tourism industry by examining trust and perceived value as mediating factors. The research implements an integrated model to test and prove information asymmetry’s direct and mediating effects on customer satisfaction by examining the literature gap. The research used a quantitative approach based on opinion polls distributed to 408 customers of hotels, tourism companies, and travel agencies who were in Egypt. SmartPLS 3 software implemented the data analysis process using partial least squares structural equation modeling (PLS-SEM). Previous studies have developed scales to measure information asymmetry and its related constructs, including customer trust, perceived value, and customer satisfaction. Multiple tests showed that the measurement tools possess both reliability and validity. Results strongly support all hypotheses: information asymmetry demonstrated significant direct negative effects on customer satisfaction (β = −0.187), trust (β = −0.520), and perceived value (β = −0.453). Conversely, customer satisfaction received significant positive direct effects from both trust (β = 0.273) and perceived value (β = 0.263). Importantly, trust (indirect effect β = −0.142) and perceived value (indirect effect β = −0.119) acted as powerful mediators, confirming that information asymmetry diminishes satisfaction largely by eroding these crucial factors. Crucially, the results demonstrate that the negative impact of information asymmetry on customer satisfaction is significantly mediated jointly through two parallel pathways: the erosion of customer trust and the impairment of perceived value. The research adds theoretical support to information asymmetry theory with its findings while als

hot.title: The role of robo-advisors in behavioural finance, shaping investment decisions
hot.abstract: This study focuses on using artificial intelligence-driven financial robo-advisors in the investment decision-making domain by retail investors. Based on heuristic and prospect theory, the researcher aims to examine how AI-powered financial robo-advisors (AIPFRA), through their perceived interactivity, personalisation, autonomy, algorithm interpretation and structural assurance, influence retail investors’ loss aversion and overconfidence biases, ultimately enhancing robo-advisor usage in investment decision-making. Using purposive sampling, data from 461 retail investors were collected and analysed through structural equation modelling using SmartPLS 4.0. The results indicate that, except for structural assurance, robo-advisors’ perceived personalisation, interactivity, autonomy and algorithm transparency substantially mitigated investors’ overconfidence and loss-aversion biases, enhancing robo-advisor usage for investment decision-making. The study highlights the significance of financial literacy in moderating the relationship between biases and the use of robo-advisors. The study contributed by extending Heuristic and Prospect Theories to the AI-driven robo-advisor investment ecosystem. The study comprehensively explains how AI-powered robo-advisor design features impact investor psychology and adoption by bridging behavioural biases such as loss aversion and overconfidence with technology mechanisms like interactivity, personalisation, autonomy, algorithm interpretability and structural assurance. The results can help financial institutions implement user-centric advisory tools and help fintech developers create more bias-aware robo-advisors.

hot.title: The Impact of 7Ps Green Marketing Mix on Customer Commitment and Willingness to Pay a Premium Price: Evidence from Vietnam
hot.abstract: As consumers prioritize environmental issues and sustainable development, using green elements in marketing strategy has become valuable. This research examines how the 7Ps green marketing mix influences customer commitment and willingness to pay a premium price for green products, focusing on the role of green brand loyalty, association, and perceived quality. A PLS-SEM analysis of survey data from 571 young Vietnamese consumers reveals that different green 7Ps components exert distinct effects on green consumer-based brand equity (CBBE). While prior research largely focuses on green product, price, place and promotion, limited attention has been given to green human factors, process, and physical evidence, which this study addresses. The findings of this study not only confirm the significant influence of green CBBE dimensions on consumer commitment and willingness to pay a premium price but also enriches the green marketing and consumer behavior literature. Moreover, these provide practical strategies for businesses and policymakers in emerging markets to effectively leverage green marketing, strengthen consumer commitment, implement premium pricing strategies, and contribute to advancing the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).

hot.title: The push-pull-mooring model of consumer service switching: a meta-analytical review to guide future research
hot.venue: Journal of Service Theory and Practice
hot.abstract: Purpose For nearly 2 decades, the push-pull-mooring (PPM) model has been used frequently by scholars to explain consumers’ service switching intention and behavior. However, heterogeneity and incomparability between PPM model studies are prevalent issues: The chosen predictor variables, their categorization, their measurement, reported effect sizes, and effect directions vary considerably. By addressing these issues, the present meta-analytical review enables future researchers applying the PPM model to identify relevant variables and use valid measurements. Design/methodology/approach Based on 148 empirical studies employing the PPM model, the variables used to predict consumers’ service switching intention and behavior, their frequency of use, their categorization into push, pull, and mooring factors, and their measurement are assessed. The effect sizes and directions of the relationships between these variables and consumers’ service switching intention and behavior are analyzed using meta-analytic structural equation modeling. Additionally, the predictive capacity of this model and the influence of moderators are assessed. Findings Among the 148 empirical studies, 382 different independent variables were used. The three most frequently used and distinctly categorized independent variables are dissatisfaction (push), alternative attractiveness (pull), and switching costs (mooring). Overall, 152 unique sources were cited to measure these variables and the dependent variables. Dissatisfaction and alternative attractiveness increase switching intention, which positively affects switching behavior, while switching costs decrease switching intention. The model explains 30% of the variance in switching intention and 31% of the variance in switching behavior. Originality/va

hot.title: Impulse buying in live streaming commerce: A literature review and research agenda
hot.abstract: Impulse buying in live streaming commerce (LSC) is an emerging phenomenon characterized by spontaneous, unplanned purchases driven by real-time social interactions. Despite increasing scholarly attention, the existing literature remains fragmented, lacking consensus on antecedents, theoretical perspectives, and outcomes. This fragmentation hinders theoretical development and accumulation of knowledge of this research stream. To address these issues, this study provides a systematic review of impulse buying in LSC, synthesizing key research trends, theoretical foundations, and methodological approaches. Drawing on the stimulus-organism-response (S-O-R) framework, we propose an integrative framework that consolidates antecedents, psychological mechanisms, and outcomes of impulse buying within LSC. This comprehensive synthesis clarifies existing inconsistencies and offers structured avenues for future research. For practitioners, our framework identifies critical platform features, streamer attributes, and consumer characteristics that influence impulse buying, enabling more effective strategies and responsible practices in LSC.

hot.title: Impulsive Buying Tendencies and Personality: Cognitive and Affective Aspects
hot.abstract: Impulsive buying is a growing problem in modern society with significant financial and psychological consequences, and it is necessary to examine the mechanisms underlying it. Understanding the mechanisms driving this behavior is crucial. Impulsive buying consists of two key aspects: a cognitive aspect, characterized by a lack of planning and reflection, and an affective aspect, involving emotional responses that can occur before, during, or after a purchase. This study aims to explore the relationship between personality traits, as measured by the HEXACO model, and tendencies toward impulsive buying. Specifically, it examines how the HEXACO traits differentially predict the cognitive and affective components of impulsive buying tendencies. Data were collected from a sample of 420 students, with 32 excluded due to incomplete responses, resulting in a final sample of 388 students (155 men, 233 women) with an average age of 22.8. Hierarchical regression analyses revealed that HEXACO personality domains significantly predicted overall impulsive buying tendencies. As expected, Honesty–Humility and Conscientiousness were negatively associated with impulsive buying, while Emotionality and Extraversion positively predicted impulsive buying tendencies. Moreover, Honesty–Humility, Conscientiousness, and Extraversion significantly predicted the cognitive component of impulsive buying, while Honesty–Humility and Emotionality were significant predictors of the affective component. These findings suggest the importance of educating individuals, from an early age, on the negative consequences of impulsive buying, effective money-saving strategies, and the principles of mental accounting.

hot.title: Decomposing Brand Loyalty: An Examination of Loyalty Subcomponents, Product Price Range, Consumer Personality, and Willingness to Pay
hot.abstract: Brand loyalty is widely recognized as a key driver of consumer behavior, significantly influencing their willingness to pay more for preferred brands. This study explores the relationship between brand loyalty, its components, willingness to pay, consumer personality traits, and product price range. A tailored online survey involving participants aged 18 to 60 revealed a strong positive correlation between brand loyalty and increased willingness to pay. The findings also underscore the influence of Conscientiousness and Energy on brand loyalty, alongside the moderating effect of product price range. Specifically, habit-based loyalty dominates low-priced, routine purchases, while higher-priced decisions involve deeper cognitive-affective evaluations. These insights offer valuable guidance for enhancing customer satisfaction and optimizing brand profitability.

hot.title: Anthropomorphism in artificial intelligence: a game-changer for brand marketing
hot.abstract: Abstract The expansion of brands adopting artificial intelligence services with human characteristics, such as chatbots, has revolutionized digital marketing strategies, transforming how companies reach and engage customers. This technological innovation is reshaping digital interactions between companies and consumers, offering a more personalized and efficient experience. This study explores the influence of chatbot anthropomorphism on customer engagement and purchasing decision-making with brands that use this artificial intelligence service. Data from a questionnaire with 1319 participants was analyzed using partial least squares method. Chatbot anthropomorphism has a more positive influence on purchasing decision-making when this relationship is mediated by customer engagement. In turn, customer involvement also has a positive influence on decision-making. The results emphasize that for a greater influence of the chatbot's anthropomorphism on purchasing decision-making, the customer must first be engaged with the chatbot. This research illuminates a new path in the domain of AI-enabled brand interactions, showing the distinct influence of anthropomorphism in chatbots on customer satisfaction, trust and loyalty, thus revolutionizing traditional paradigms of consumer-brand engagement and decision-making processes. By exploring the intricate dynamics between customer engagement with anthropomorphized chatbots and purchasing decisions, this study breaks new ground, offering unprecedented insight into the transformative potential of human-like chatbot interactions in shaping consumer behavior and brand relationships.

hot.title: Drivers of Purchase Intentions of Generation Z on Eco-Products
hot.abstract: Concerns about environmental protection and sustainable consumption increased among Generation Z, as a consequence of more perceived risks emerging in the context of climate change and depletion of natural resources. The aim of the present research was to identify the main factors that influence the intention to purchase eco-products among the young generation. Quantitative marketing research was carried out on a sample of 269 Gen Z. The research results proved that purchasing intention for eco-products is strongly influenced by the perceived quality of environmentally friendly products, consumer consciousness about eco-products, perceived value of green products, and consumer trust in ecological products. Lower influences were recorded in terms of perceived price and perceived availability of eco-products, with improved total effects when considering the mediating role of eco-trust. Consequently, the provision of eco-products could lead to image benefits for organizations.

hot.title: Electroencephalography Studies on Marketing Stimuli: A Literature Review and Future Research Agenda
hot.abstract: ABSTRACT This study aims to explore the application of electroencephalography (EEG) tools in examining latent consumer behavior, emphasizing emotions, attention, preferences, memory, and decision‐making in response to various marketing stimuli (e.g., products, pricing, branding, and advertising). This study adopts a thematic review approach, employing a systematic literature review methodology (e.g., Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta‐Analyses [PRISMA] protocol). Our investigation unearthed 155 articles from the Scopus and Web of Science databases, spanning 2010–2023. The findings reveal a marked increase in EEG‐related research, underscoring its effectiveness in examining consumers' reactions to marketing stimuli. This rise reflects a growing recognition among researchers of EEG's ability to address marketing research challenges, particularly in advertising, product development, branding, and pricing. EEG research predominantly targets advertising, followed by products, branding, and pricing, and delves deeply into consumer behavior aspects such as emotional, cognitive, and decision‐making processes. The study further highlights EEG's cutting‐edge potential to predict ad success, optimize product features, and refine pricing strategies with unprecedented accuracy. Specifically, emotion‐based ads profoundly influence decision‐making, offering novel insights into consumers' emotional engagement. This study emphasizes EEG's groundbreaking role in minimizing verbal biases and revealing consumer behavior, which is increasingly recognized as critical for developing more effective marketing strategies. This review underscores EEG's theoretical and practical contributions and offers pioneering insights into marketing effectiveness and consumer engagement

hot.title: From perceived green product quality to purchase intention: the roles of price sensitivity and environmental concern
hot.abstract: Purpose This research seeks to address the existing gaps in the literature by rigorously investigating the influence of consumers’ perceived green product quality (PPQ), price sensitivity to green products (PRS) and environmental concern (ENC) on their intention to purchase green products (GPI) within the context of green circular economies. Furthermore, the study will explore the role of PRS as a mediator and ENC as a moderator by applying the price-expectancy model (PEM) and social exchange theory (SET). Design/methodology/approach The purposive sampling technique was employed to analyse 412 online survey responses from consumers, utilising partial least squares structural equation modelling (PLS-SEM). Findings The findings indicate a positive relationship between PPQ and PRS and PRS and GPI, contradicting the hypothesised negative associations. This suggests that as consumers become increasingly price-sensitive, they perceive green products to possess higher quality without diminishing their purchase intentions. Additionally, PPQ is positively associated with GPI, implying that enhanced perceptions of quality directly contribute to an increased intention to purchase green products. Furthermore, the results demonstrate that while ENC moderates the relationship between PPQ and PRS, its practical significance is limited. Practical implications This research emphasises to marketers that they should prioritise quality features while addressing PRS, particularly for environmentally concerned consumers, which can effectively shape consumers’ GPI. Originality/value This study’s originality lies in its integration of PRS and ENC within green consumerism. This offers valuable insights into green marketing and provides marketers with practical strategies to tackle the challenge

hot.title: Trends and development in green and sustainability marketing: a bibliometrics analysis using VOSviewer
hot.abstract: The recent global environmental crisis and climate change have prompted greater interest among global citizens in sustainability issues. Consumers are demanding more to be done by product and service suppliers to ensure sustainability. This has sparked research and academic interest in understanding how various organisations position themselves from a sustainability perspective. This study emerges from the need to understand trends and developments in sustainability marketing. To this end, this study uses bibliometric data from the Scopus database to examine this development. The data were analysed using Microsoft Excel and VOSviewer. The study found significant growth in the literature on green and sustainable marketing which is indicative of the subject over the past couple of years. In many respects green marketing is seen by many enterprises as playing a central role in shaping consumer perceptions and brand loyalty in many markets. However, green marketing and sustainability face various challenges such as misleading claims and greenwashing which threaten consumer confidence in sustainability efforts. Overall, this study found that integrating sustainability into marketing strategies fosters environmental responsibility, builds consumer trust, and enhances business performance. In addition, frameworks such as the theory of planned behaviour (TPB) provide a foundation for understanding consumers’ green attitudes and adoption behaviour. Greenwashing can be addressed by transparency, education, and regulatory compliance. Finally, practical recommendations include fostering international cooperation, developing targeted capacity-building initiatives, and leveraging sustainability marketing to achieve the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).
